documentation.content: Most of Maple's answers in the last minute skipped the search. Check which prompt version is serving: `gcloud run services describe maple --region northamerica-northeast2`. If it is not the champion, move traffic back: `gcloud run services update-traffic maple --to-tags champion=100`. maple-guard does this on its own; confirm in its log.

conditions.displayName: More than 70% of answers skipped the search
